semiconductor_relevance: Low — UC Components Inc primarily provides fasteners and O-rings, which are not core semiconductor products.
summary: UC Components Inc specializes in precision-cleaned fasteners and O-rings, designed for clean-critical applications. Their products are vacuum-baked and cleanroom packaged, ensuring readiness for demanding environments. The company emphasizes quality and customer service, catering to various industries including semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.United States: The company operates from a 16,000-square-foot facility in Morgan Hill, California.
